quality_guards: Confined-space controls depend on the space, atmosphere, contents, isolation, work method, worker competence and rescue arrangements.
Confined-space evidence is space-, task- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fatality or exposure probability.
Noise controls depend on measured exposure, peak levels, duration, frequency content, work patterns and individual susceptibility.
Workplace-noise evidence is exposure- and task-specific and is not an exact parcel-level hearing-loss probability.
Vibration controls depend on the tool or vehicle, vibration magnitude, exposure duration, maintenance, posture and worker health.
Vibration evidence is equipment-, exposure- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Manual-handling risk depends on the task, individual, load, environment, frequency, posture and available mechanical aids.
Manual-handling evidence is task-, load- and worker-specific and is not an exact parcel-level musculoskeletal-injury probability.
DSE controls depend on workstation design, equipment, posture, work duration, environment, user needs and work organisation.
DSE evidence is workstation- and user-specific and is not an exact parcel-level musculoskeletal or visual-strain probability.
Pressure-system controls depend on the fluid, pressure, equipment, protective devices, installation, operating limits and examination history.
Pressure-system evidence is equipment-, fluid- and operating-condition-specific and is not an exact parcel-level rupture probability.
Lifting controls depend on equipment, load, environment, people, complexity, stability, accessories and examination status.
Lifting-operation evidence is equipment-, load- and operation-specific and is not an exact parcel-level dropped-load probability.
Work-equipment controls depend on equipment type, intended use, condition, guarding, energy sources, users and maintenance activity.
PUWER evidence is equipment-, task- and user-specific and is not an exact parcel-level machinery-injury probability.
Slip and trip controls depend on surface, contamination, footwear, cleaning, lighting, weather, traffic and user vulnerability.
Slip-and-trip evidence is surface-, activity- and condition-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fall probability.
Excavation controls depend on ground, depth, support, water, nearby structures, plant loads, access, services and inspection findings.
Excavation evidence is site-, ground- and work-method-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collapse or service-strike probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
